records.title: GRADE: Benchmarking Discipline-Informed Reasoning in Image Editing
records.reason: GRADE is a benchmark for discipline-informed reasoning in image editing; the primary abstract presents evaluation coverage, not an efficiency method.

records.title: CodePercept: Code-Grounded Visual STEM Perception for MLLMs
records.reason: CodePercept introduces code-grounded visual STEM perception data/evaluation for MLLMs; the abstract emphasizes perception capability, not reducing inference resources.

records.title: Covenant-72B: Pre-Training a 72B LLM with Trustless Peers Over-the-Internet
records.reason: Covenant-72B concerns trustless distributed pre-training of a large language model; its primary abstract is about training infrastructure, not inference-time efficiency.

records.title: FACE: A Face-based Autoregressive Representation for High-Fidelity and Efficient Mesh Generation
records.reason: FACE represents 3D meshes with face-based autoregressive tokens and evaluates mesh-generation fidelity/speed. Its tokenization and generation target are 3D meshes, not language-model inference.

records.title: Learning from Synthetic Data Improves Multi-hop Reasoning
records.reason: The primary text studies synthetic-data training for multi-hop reasoning and evaluates reasoning performance. It does not establish reduced inference compute, memory, latency, or serving cost.
